mapper.insert: insert into transaction(order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, money, type) values(#{orderNo}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{money}, #{type})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.order_no, t.buyer_id, t.seller_id, t.money, t.type, t.create_time, b.nickname as buyerName, s.nickname as sellerName FROM transaction t LEFT JOIN user b ON t.buyer_id = b.id LEFT JOIN user s ON t.seller_id = s.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
